career_ladder.note: The RSMSSB Common Eligibility Test (Senior Secondary Level) is a statutory qualifying gateway examination under the Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services (Common Eligibility Test) Rules, 2022. It governs recruitment to Class 12-level subordinate posts across Rajasthan Government departments, primarily Junior Assistant / Clerk Grade-II (Level L-5), Rajasthan Police Constable (Level L-5), Forest Guard (Level L-4), Hostel Superintendent (Level L-5), and Jamadar Grade-II (Level L-5). The career progression outlined below reflects the flagship benchmark clerical posting (Junior Assistant / Clerk Grade-II).

exam_scheme.note: Under Rule 7 of the Rajasthan Subordinate & Ministerial Services (CET) Rules 2022, the Senior Secondary CET consists of a single-stage objective written examination of 150 questions carrying 300 marks for a duration of 3 hours. There is no negative marking. The score card is valid for qualifying candidates for 15-times category-wise shortlisting in subsequent post-specific recruitment examinations.

stages.source_label: RSMSSB CET Senior Secondary Level Detailed Advertisement & Scheme

papers.paper_name: Composite Paper — Rajasthan History, Art, Culture, Indian & Rajasthan Geography, Polity, Economy, General Science, Reasoning, General Hindi, General English, Basic Computer & Current Affairs
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking in Common Eligibility Test
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit scorecard generated; candidates scoring top 15x vacancies or 40% aggregate eligible for departmental recruitment

financial_package.note: Package computed for the primary Class 12-level benchmark post recruited through CET (Junior Assistant / Clerk Grade-II, Level L-5) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹14,600 per month is paid without allowances. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹20,800 is drawn.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Level L-5 Schedule
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on Level L-5 entry basic pay of ₹20,800 at 58% DA (₹12,064 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18% depending on city classification: ₹1,872 to ₹3,744), city compensatory allowance where applicable, net of State Insurance & General Provident Fund / Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS) deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department notifications
House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 9% (Y/Z areas) or 18% (Jaipur and major cities)
Comprehensive cashless medical treatment under Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS)
Pension coverage under Rajasthan Civil Services Pension Rules (Old Pension Scheme restored in 2022)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and privilege leave encashment benefits per state rules
